task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to FRONT_CRATE, pick it up as obstacle, move it to TEMP_ZONE, then navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, pick it up, navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, and place MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR that needs to be removed
TEMP_ZONE is a suitable temporary location to place the removed obstacle
FRONT_CRATE is graspable by the CAR robot
MEDICINE_BOTTLE is graspable by the CAR robot
After removing FRONT_CRATE, the path to MEDICINE_BOTTLE and MEDICAL_TABLE is clear
